{{Top}}
A '''medical scanner''', also known as a '''hand scanner''', '''medpac scanner''', '''medisensor''', '''diagnoster''', '''Hand-Held Diagnostic Scanner'''<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> or '''medical scanner'''<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was a type of medical device that could be used to determine a patient's medical condition. Medisensor's were short-ranged devices but could be patched into larger sensor systems to increase their range. They were often included in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]]. [[Wilek Nereus]] used a Medisensor to monitor [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] health after he allegedly ingested a [[Olabrian trichoid]]. The [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech]] [[RFX/K Medisensor]] was a type of medisensor.

[[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]] contained a medisensor to diagnose a patient's injuries and suggest recommended treatment.<ref name="GFT" />
